sections.title: Kansas corporate income and franchise taxes

rows.label: Corporate income tax normal rate
rows.note: Cut from the statutory 4% to 3.5% from Jan 1, 2024 under the APEX Act (K.S.A. 74-50,321). No further cut for tax year 2026 was found.

source.title: Kansas Register Vol. 42 No. 35 (Aug 31, 2023), Kansas Department of Revenue: Notice of Corporate Income Tax Normal Rate Reduction

rows.label: Additional corporate tax on taxable income over $50,000
rows.note: Kansas calls this the corporate surtax; it is added to the normal rate on income above $50,000 (combined 6.5%).

source.title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-32,110 (c) Corporations

rows.label: Bank privilege tax rates
rows.value: 1.94% of net income plus 2.125% on net income over $25,000
rows.note: National and state banks pay this privilege tax instead of the corporate income tax (K.S.A. 79-1107), for tax year 2024 and later.

source.title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-1107
Kansas Register Vol. 42 No. 35 (Aug 31, 2023), Kansas Department of Revenue: Notice of Corporate Income Tax Normal Rate Reduction

sections.title: Kansas property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Cities, townships, school districts and other taxing subdivisions (collected by the county treasurer)
rows.note: Counties also levy; each body certifies its levy to the county clerk by October 1.

source.title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-1801

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Property Valuation (Director of Property Valuation)
rows.note: The division's page (ksrevenue.gov/pvd.html) could not be reached; duties quoted from statute.

source.title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 75-5105a Director of property valuation; powers and duties

rows.label: Residential assessment rate
rows.note: Homes are taxed on 11.5% of appraised market value; commercial/industrial real property 25%, farmland (use value) 30%.

source.title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-1439

rows.label: State property tax levies
rows.value: 1.5 mills statewide (1 mill for higher education + 0.5 mill for state institutions); plus a mandatory 20-mill school levy for 2025-26 and 2026-27 remitted to the state
rows.note: The compiled statutes name levy year 2025 for the 1 and 0.5 mill state levies (K.S.A. 76-6b01, 76-6b04); the 20 mills is K.S.A. 72-5142.

source.title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 76-6b01 (also 76-6b04 and 72-5142)

sections.title: Kansas real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Mortgage registration tax
rows.value: None since 2019: repealed (was 0.26% of the mortgage principal)
rows.note: Phased out 2015-2018 and repealed from calendar year 2019; recording fees were raised instead.
